description: Comprehensive measure of slippage across multiple trades or venues.
Bid-ask spread averaged over the last 30 minutes (in instrument currency)
Bid-ask spread over the last 30 minutes expressed in basis points
Difference between best bid and best ask price for the security (in instrument currency)
Bid-ask spread expressed in basis points (normalized to mid/VWAP)
Modeled slippage/transaction cost estimate for executing an order equal to 35% of average daily volume, derived from spread-based microstructure and VWAP data; point-in-time and embargoed
Maximum estimated transaction cost for a trade.
Estimated transaction cost at the 10th percentile for a trade.
